_about: B4 batch glossary (concepts/llm-and-system-prompt, concepts/tools-and-mcp, concepts/skills). Owner: B4 writer. Search core.json and other batch files before you add a term here.

provider-adapter.short: A plugin that streams model calls for one or more provider names, registered with ctx.llm.registerAdapter().
provider-adapter.long: Only stream() is required; every other LlmAdapter method has a default ({{cite packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts:208}}, {{cite packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts:302}}).

system-prompt.short: The assembled instruction text for one step, built by joining every registered prompt section in order.
system-prompt.long: The loop renders the assembly, then commits it to the session as a system/message event instead of a hidden request field ({{cite packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:442}}, {{cite docs/architecture.md:112}}).
